title: Joe Oliver at Copper Raider Hall and his mutes
summary: Bailey met Joe Oliver at the hall, ranks him just behind Manuel Perez, and recalls his hat mute.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Now where did you hear Joe Oliver? You mentioned hearing him.
Well I met him at the Copper Raider Hall. He's one of the good cornet players right behind Manuel Perez. Yeah, he took me at the Copper Raider Hall. An outstanding cornet player going.
Did those cornet players use many mutes? Different kind of things for me?
Yeah, well. Well Joe Oliver most used his doobie. He used it until he died. When he's doobie.
And what about the other fellas?
Well he used to have, used to have things to put in cornet. But I'm talking about Joe Oliver. He had them too, but he used to use that hat most. Yeah, Joe Oliver used to use that big ol' doobie.
